title: EXP-096 - Hello World Part 6 Section 4: Data Change FX_CalcOrderTotal on FX_ItemGridCol and FX_CountGridCol, Grid Control Check Before the Change, One Designer Save, Runtime Grid Recalculation Check
objective: Follow hello-world-pt6.md Section 4 (03:43-04:16), adapted to FX_ names and User scope. First, as a control, in the Web Client change the order 1 Count to 3 through the grid row (unsaved) before any Designer change and record whether Order Total recalculates (the EXP-095 handler is already wired to the detail-view FX_ItemCombobox and FX_CountEdit only); discard it. Then in the Web Designer set Events > Data Change = FX_CalcOrderTotal on the grid columns FX_ItemGridCol and FX_CountGridCol, perform exactly one Designer Save and verify persistence after one Designer close/reopen. Finally, in the Web Client, on the order 1 grid row change Count 2 -> 3 and Item dumbbell -> eggs without saving, record Order Total after each, discard with close + No and verify both orders unchanged after a reopen. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Before browser interaction read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt6.md Section 4 and its transcript lines (03:43-04:16), recipes/components/apply-component-class.md (the runtime steps, the grid splitter step and the pitfalls), recipes/session/session-expiry-and-stale-designer.md, and only the final Outcome (operator) sections of the EXP-092 and EXP-095 records. Do not read those records in full.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-096-hello-world-part-6-section-4-fx-orders-grid-column-data-change.md and evidence/EXP-096/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task; never sign in inside the portal's embedded app frame (refused, EXP-080-R2) but use the procedure's top-level portal navigation. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt, menu or unsaved runtime change open across tasks. After any pause, inspect the state read-only before acting and never replay an earlier action.

Designer gate (read-only): the Designer is in User scope and clean on FX_Orders (Save and Undo disabled; open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry if needed); the Details > Event Handlers grid shows FX_CalcOrderTotal (Form Script Method, CalcOrderTotal(P(FX_Count),P(FX_ItmsCost))); Data Change reads FX_CalcOrderTotal on FX_ItemCombobox and FX_CountEdit and is blank on FX_ItemGridCol and FX_CountGridCol. If anything differs, or the session shows the server-event error, record it and stop blocked.

Runtime control (before any Designer change): in the Web Client, if FX_Orders is open close it once (clean); open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (operator-approved route, EXP-093), switch to Filter in Place if needed, leave every criterion blank and press F4 once (move between orders only by clicking their row-number cells); verify order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and order 2: Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99. With order 1 selected, if the order 1 grid row Count, Item and Order Total cells are not visible, widen the grid once by dragging the splitter between the grid and the detail view (a coordinate drag, as in EXP-092; record the layout before and after with screenshots). Click the order 1 grid row Count cell once, select its whole content, type 3 once and press Tab once; without any Save record the grid row Count, Cost and Order Total and the detail-view Count, Cost and Order Total, with a screenshot, and any message verbatim. Tutorial expectation: no recalculation from the grid (Order Total stays 90.00); record whatever is shown as observed only. Then close the runtime FX_Orders Form once; answer No once to the prompt to save changes and record its exact text; if any other prompt appears (for example about grid or splitter layout changes) answer No once and record its exact text; if no save prompt appears, record it and stop blocked for the coordinator without further action.

Component events: in the Designer select FX_ItemGridCol in the Details > Components grid (or the Properties component selector), set its Events > Data Change field to FX_CalcOrderTotal (choose from its drop-down; type the exact name only if it is not listed) and commit it; read it back with a screenshot. Do the same once for FX_CountGridCol. Never set Primary, Lose Focus, Gain Focus or any other field, and never change any other component or the grid itself (no column resize, reorder, hide or add). At most one correction per field. If the Properties route offers no Data Change field for a grid column, record it and stop blocked (the tutorial's Edit Grid Columns dialog needs a coordinator decision).

Perform exactly one Designer Save through the native toolbar Save and record its native response verbatim (toast, dialog or error) with a screenshot. If an error appears, record it and stop blocked; never retry the Save.

Persistence: close the clean FX_Orders Designer Form once through its Form-tab control (take a fresh snapshot immediately before the click and use only its references; record any prompt; if a save prompt appears, answer No once and record its text) and reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry. Verify Save is disabled; read back the Data Change value of FX_ItemGridCol, FX_CountGridCol, FX_ItemCombobox and FX_CountEdit and the Event Handlers row. If Save is enabled after the readback, close once answering No and reopen once to restore clean; if it is still enabled, record it and stop blocked.

Runtime grid check: in the Web Client open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (operator-approved route, EXP-093), switch to Filter in Place if needed, leave every criterion blank and press F4 once (move between orders only by clicking their row-number cells); verify order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and order 2: Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99 unchanged (this also verifies the control discard). With order 1 selected, if the order 1 grid row Count, Item and Order Total cells are not visible, widen the grid once by dragging the splitter between the grid and the detail view (a coordinate drag, as in EXP-092; record the layout before and after with screenshots). Click the order 1 grid row Count cell once, select its whole content, type 3 once and press Tab once; without any Save record the grid row and detail-view Count, Cost and Order Total with a screenshot. Expected by the tutorial: Order Total 135.00. Then click the order 1 grid row Item cell once, open its drop-down once and choose eggs once (never type); record the grid row and detail-view Item, Item Description, Cost, Count and Order Total with a screenshot. Expected: Cost 6.99 and Order Total 20.97 (3 x 6.99). Record whatever is shown, and any message or error verbatim (acknowledge an error once and continue to the discard).

Discard: close the runtime FX_Orders Form once; answer No once to the prompt to save changes and record its exact text; if any other prompt appears (for example about grid or splitter layout changes) answer No once and record its exact text; if no save prompt appears, record it and stop blocked for the coordinator without further action. Then reopen FX_Orders once through the recent-forms entry (blank criteria, F4 once; row-number cells only) and verify order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and order 2: Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99 unchanged; record whether the widened grid layout persisted. Close the runtime FX_Orders Form once at the end (clean).

Capture screenshots of the Designer gate (Event Handlers row and the four Data Change values), the runtime baselines, the splitter layout before and after each drag, the control result after the grid Count change, each Data Change readback, the Save response, the reopened Designer readbacks, the grid row after the Count change and after the Item change, each prompt before answering, and the reopened orders. Use a distinct filename for every capture; never overwrite an earlier screenshot.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task; after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.

notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-095; the operator said yes on 2026-10-15. EXP-095 wired FX_CalcOrderTotal to the detail-view FX_ItemCombobox and FX_CountEdit, and the unsaved detail-view changes recalculated Order Total (135.00, then 20.97). The tutorial says grid edits need their own Data Change wiring, and its caution says form-level wiring should not be presumed to reach the grid; the T1 control (a grid Count edit before the Designer change) tests that and gives the attribution EXP-095 lacked. Data Change is set through the Components grid and Properties panel (the route proven in EXP-095) instead of the tutorial's Edit Grid Columns dialog. The grid needs one splitter drag per runtime open to show the Count, Item and Order Total cells (EXP-092; the widened layout did not persist and no layout prompt appeared). All runtime changes are discarded with close + No. EXP-095 lessons applied: fresh snapshot before each click, distinct screenshot filenames. exact_values: FX_Orders, FX_CalcOrderTotal, FX_ItemGridCol, FX_CountGridCol, FX_ItemCombobox, FX_CountEdit, 135.00, 20.97, 90.00, FX001, FX002, dumbbell, eggs. deny_browser_javascript.
